# Neutral Academia

Neutral Academia is a minimalist theme that fits both dark and light academia aesthetics. Its typography is set with Cormorant Semibold for headings, Inter for folders and Manrope for note text.

![Neutral Academia screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-neutral-academia/HEAD/images/neutralacademia-dark-thumbnail.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Neutral Academia"
    author: "incantatem2"
    repo:   "incantatem2/Obsidian-neutral-academia"
    slug:   "neutral-academia"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/neutral-academia"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-neutral-academia"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-neutral-academia/HEAD/images/neutralacademia-dark-thumbnail.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimalist, elegant theme that fits dark and light academia aesthetics. Use Cormorant Semibold for headings, Inter for folders, and Manrope for note text for refined, readable typography."
}
```
